notes.title: Demo Release Date & Royal Life Coach
notes.content: [p][b]We’re thrilled to announce that the [i]demo launches August 7th![/i][/b][/p][p]And just in time, a new face has joined the ranks of His Majesty’s loyal staff:[/p][p][b]The Royal Life Coach[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45635693/4028471d5ecaae97e913b8cd668e8f0a19f5a8ab.png"][/img][/p][p]This invaluable (and questionably qualified) advisor can now be consulted by your guards to learn [b]active skills[/b] - essential tools for survival, deception, and dramatic exits. These include:[/p][list][*][p][i]Spontaneous Combustion[/i] – go out with a bang (literally)[/p][/*][*][p][i]Trap Setting[/i] – because subtlety is an art[/p][/*][*][p][i]King’s Double Disguise[/i] – fool enemies, confuse allies[/p][/*][*][p][i]Voluntary Departure from the Mortal Realm[/i] – to free up pension space[/p][/*][*][p]and many more ...[/p][/*][/list][p]Your guards might not live long... but at least now they can die with flair.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45635693/0308d6a8a7f1fc9abfab34d63b4a99112e1395b7.png"][/img][/p][p][b][u]Save the date and play our Demo![/u][/b][/p]

notes.title: Development Update
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45635693/6c7332d305b52b8b4f1423c6bf6ef432ed72441f.png"][/img]We’re deep in the trenches, finalizing the content for our upcoming demo - and we’re stoked to introduce three new characters we’ve just added! Here’s a quick peek for you:  [/p][h3][b]Ogra[/b][/h3][p][i]"Ogra's morning routine includes sword drills, intimidation practice and screaming into a well."[/i] [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Arianna[/b][/h3][p][i]"The simple folk call Arianna a role model. That’s only because they haven’t heard her, three ales in, ranting about landlords and property taxes."[/i] [/p][p] [/p][h3][b]Rupert[/b][/h3][p][i]"Rupert has been in the guard for 45 years. The only thing he fears more than death is retirement."[/i][/p]
